as_told.place_text: Vatican Observatory and archives, Vatican City

plain: Sometime in the 2010s, at the Vatican Observatory in Castel Gandolfo, Italy, scientists from the European Space Agency recognized a man she calls Tyler as soon as he was introduced by his real name, and "the whole place just erupted." The scholar Diana Pasulka says she was there, and names Guy Consolmagno as part of the story. Michels, retelling it, calls the man Tim Taylor and adds that this recognition got him led into the Vatican's archives, which would show how well known and trusted the man is in those circles.
